episode_title: School Shooting in Bend, Elon Musk's Power, MN Senate Race
script_en: School Shooting in Bend, Elon Musk's Power, MN Senate Race.
Authorities say the 16-year-old suspect in a school shooting that killed three children and one teacher at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon was once a student there.
Elon Musk has influence across the economy and politics.
The major party candidates for Minnesota’s U.S.
Senate seat faced off in a debate Friday on MPR News.
Affordability and fallout from the Trump administration’s policies were key points.
